title: O you sleeping people- wake up and make Dhikr for Allah, Daim Allah!
body:
O you sleeping people- wake up and make Dhikr for Allah, Daim Allah! There
is two kinds of sleep- one is unconscious, the other conscious...
Without saying ,Bismillahi-r-Rahmani-r-Rahim' everything is bad, without
head. It makes you to be with Shaitan, not with Allah. Who is saying
'Bismillahi-r-Rahmani-r-Rahim' means to say: 'O Allah, I am asking to be
with You.' The reason for every crises is that people forget to say the
Besmela, and therefore they forget Allah. Nothing of what they do is
successful. And the angels are cursing those who are leaving Allah. Ta'ziman
wa takdiran- what a power Allah has given us with the Besmela! Its power is
without limits, you can do everything with it; it is an endless power
ocean...But people nowadays rely on machines and they measure their power in
horse power. Depensing on what is to do they use more or less powerful
motors for their machines. And depending on the purpose and depending on how
much is needed, when using the Besmela, power is sent from the endless power
oceans. So there are some people who may play with Dunya like with a ball,
when they say the Besmela, or they may make the moon to turn with their

spiritual power...It is a source that has been opened to us. Who doesn't
take from it, has no success, gets no help.
The Ottomans were ruling for 7oo years. Now people finished everything in 8o
years...To rule is not a child's play. The Ottomans were respecting the Holy
Quran and they were praying... Now they don't know any more religion, justice
or mercy. They removed the Besmela. With which right? And we are the
grandchildren of the Ottomans. They used to write the Besmela everywhere.
Now there is no more foundation. All ways are closed. The power that opens
the way in the Tariqat is also coming through the Besmela.
Use ,Bismillahi-r-Rahmani-r-Rahim' for everything, no matter what you are doing
and you will always be powerful. If not- neither America nor Russia can help
you... If everything continues like this in this country, soon they will
print 5o.ooo.ooo Lira notes or more... But we hope that the situation will
not reach beyond the 2o.ooo.ooo Lira notes... After 2oo2 the world-map will
change... You don't see- like when the sky is covered with clouds...
The Middle East is the most precious area in the world- Sham and its
surroundings are full of Barakat, the Prophet said, including
Bait-ul-Maqdis. The world map, the countries and the governments will
change, and also people will change soon, until Muharram. I am expecting the
appearance of a mighty power, that will destroy Kufr and dhulm.
Who is asking to do goodness, must use 'Bismillahi-r-Rahmani-r-Rahim',
individually and commonly, as a nation. Otherwise you cannot do anything.
May Allah grant us a good end. We say the Besmela and trust in Allah.
Nimrod was asking the prophet Ibrahim a.s.: 'Where are the armies of your
Lord?' 'Just wait, they are coming', Ibrahim replied, and just a big black
cloud full with moscitos was approaching, and they finished the whole army
of Nimrod... That was the will of Allah... And then there is also lightening

from the skies, coming on people... Coming, but the ear cannot hear anything,
and people fall down dead....
May Allah save us from the fire... Ya Muhauli hauli wa-l ahwal, hauli halina
ila ahsani hal!
